Hi Alan,

Thanks again for the call today — good conversation. Quick recap of what we heard from your side:

- Primary goal: reduce per-transaction inference cost for risk scoring while keeping P95 latency under 120ms.
- Data: model inputs will be hashed transaction records + user metadata (no raw PANs).
- Success metric: pilot should demonstrate 30% cost reduction or equivalent latency improvement.

Next steps I suggest:
1) 45-minute demo + ops deep dive (bring your platform/security folks)
2) Review SOC2/data flow artifacts ahead of the call
3) Define a short mutual action plan and a pilot timeline (4–6 weeks)

Are you available for one of these slots next week?
- Tue 22 May, 16:00–16:45 EDT
- Wed 23 May, 11:00–11:45 EDT
- Thu 24 May, 14:00–14:45 EDT

If you want, I can loop in our security lead (Marissa Cole) and solutions engineer (Evelyn Hart) now so we can align calendar-wise. Also attaching a short SOC2 summary for context (see attachment stub).

Cheers,
